title: GEMglClearStencil
description: specify the clear value for the stencil buffer

messages.description: index used when the stencil buffer is cleared

arguments.description: index used when the stencil buffer is cleared

body: [GEMglClearStencil] calls glClearStencil() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glClearStencil in the OpenGL reference.
